facts.fact: Journalist Patient Ligodi, reading UNESCO's 2025 AI readiness assessment, reports that the DRC has no national AI strategy and no specific regulation of AI use.

COD.note: Only an absence of local-language AI training content is stated; no model, dataset or computing facts.

facts.fact: The article says the DRC's National Cybersecurity Agency regulates cybersecurity and collaborates in the fight against cybercrime under the digital code.
The article says the DRC's Code du numerique punishes identity-element misuse to deceive users (article 349) and phishing identity theft (article 351).
The article says risky automated processing in the DRC falls under the control of the data protection authority (Autorite de protection des donnees).
